commit_scope: Keep native Pulse HTML intact across proxies and remove repeated archive decoding from page reads without changing history or thresholds.

roles: native Pulse source repair and release follow-through

evidence_refs: Prior PR 4088 deployed successfully at 8c3a503369b99393389479bf596c854f894d81f8 in rollout 39222985519. The public native HTML observation then failed because Cloudflare appended a beacon script to both the independent Pulse and Hati documents. Complete private response captures remain in the Pulse data volume; public beacon tokens are not copied into artifacts.

Cloudflare documents automatic-injection suppression through Cache-Control no-transform: https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/faq/ . Pulse retains no-store freshness, adds no-transform on responses and script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none' on HTML. The public observation remains strict: complete native document, no script, range navigation and response policy. No account-wide proxy/security control is disabled.

Source-sequence-keyed silence projections retain sorted max(start,end) endpoints for closed intervals and an open count. Startup derives missing or older projections from original buckets; each changed bucket publishes its count page before the checkpoint. Default pages use exact counts; full day/archive disclosures retain original rows and notes without truncation. One native clock owns page status, history, interval rows and counts.

The rolling first day chooses the smaller estimated raw-page side. Exact observed-only daily counts and weighted latency bins subtract a prefix or include a suffix. A focused native fixture split the same ten source rows into valid 2/4/4-row pages, exercising both choices with a failure, repeated latency bins and an explicitly unobserved row. Both full histograms matched direct suffix authority: prefix choice 5 observed/1 failure; suffix choice 3 observed/0 failures.

The native overlap/handoff fixture reconstructed the projection after removal and counted exactly two intervals, matching the full read: old-start/recent-end and ongoing included, wholly pre-window closure excluded. Canonical web navigation and local Pulse links remained correct.

The private full archive observation compared all twelve organs for 180 days against direct daily histograms plus raw suffix authority: every daily sample/failure/rank, window uptime and p50/p95 matched. Indexed history took 3445 ms in this observation; sample count remained 6339890. Startup count derivation took 1529 ms. These are observations, not a controlled benchmark.

Private native HTTP observed default HTML 200 in 1374 ms, 55914 string bytes; selected-day HTML 200 in 1782 ms, 56158 string bytes. Both complete, script-free, escaped and policy-bearing. No latency thresholds were changed. Public proxy behavior follows deployment.

Exact local fixture failure: form-run ./fkwu ../.cache/pulse-boundary-read-observe.bml reported unresolved fp-value. The private observation was repaired to compare every histogram bin directly and rerun on a fresh store. Initial archive rehearsal exit 137 followed listener failure: retained request.err identified unresolved wr-url from a stale private templates.bml copy. Updating that rehearsal dependency restored the listener and completed the observation; deployed source was already coherent.

Kernel source and gitlink remain 0563230ff11ef60bef75cbd3444e69d40e75e679. No kernel suite ran. All implementation is Form/BML on fkwu. OpenAI frontier reasoning authored the change; exact model/task token counts are unavailable. form-cli ask returned unrelated teachings for portfolio ownership, not sufficient native grounding. The Python portfolio projection latency remains a separate source finding, not a repaired or accepted allowance.

local_validation.summary: Focused native overlap/count and both boundary choices; one 180-day all-organ archive equivalence; default/day native HTTP and response policy.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Pulse counts intervals exactly without decoding every note, reads the smaller exact rolling boundary and owns a script-free no-transform document.
test_flows: Private archive equivalence and native document response
